Name: Luny's Natural Dirt Modular Recolor
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2mjbfye.png[/img]

﻿(The miscolored tile in the screenshots has been fixed now. (￣▽￣*)ゞ)


[left] ﻿This is the first part of a modular recolor series I'm planning. This mod recolors all the dirt in the valley to be a more earthy tone, and also stays consistent throughout Spring, Summer, and Fall. Winter has a lighter frosted color. Personally I always found it a little odd that the dirt changed color with the seasons instead of just the foliage. I always felt like it made more sense for the color to be consistent and only the grass and foliage change. So that's what I decided to go for with this. If you only want this color for specific seasons then fear not! This mod is fully configurable and each season can be disabled separately.

[b]

﻿What this mod changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] ﻿Recolors the dirt for Spring, Summer, and Fall to a browner earthy tone.
[*] ﻿Recolors the dirt in winter to a frosted earthy tone.
[*] ﻿When the weather is snow, the dirt recolor disables, giving the feeling of the freshly fallen snow covering the ground.
[*] ﻿Changes the color of tilled dirt to be a darker earthy color.
[*] ﻿Changes the color of the cliffsides during winter to be an earthy color to match the dirt, instead of being blue. 
[*] ﻿Option to change the dirt on Ginger Island, but this is still a work in progress and may look odd in certain areas.
[/list]


[b] ﻿Tilesheet compatibility list:[/b]
[list]
[*] ﻿Alvadea's Tilesheets
[*] [s]﻿[/s]Alvadea's Farm Maps - Walpurgisnacht 
[*] ﻿MixedBag's Tilesheets 
[*] ﻿SVE has been working as well, but I'm still looking around and testing it. Let me know if you encounter any miscolored dirt tiles.
[/list]


[b] ﻿Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] ﻿None currently!
[/list]

[b]﻿The inspiration for this came from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Aimon's Witchy Dirt and Grass[/url]﻿[/b], and I used it as a reference to figure out how to start this. So BIG credit to Aimon for coming up with the idea to begin with! Without their mod I never would've considered this as a possibility. Speaking of, Witchy Dirt And Grass is also compatible with this mod, as long as you adjust the configs to not attempt replacing the same aspects. So for example, if you want to use the dirt from this mod and the grass from Aimon's, that's absolutely compatible! (⁀ᗢ⁀)

﻿If you notice any tiles or textures that seem out of place, let me know and I'll look into it! A screenshot showing the tile will help tremendously for identifying it. Without a screenshot I can't guarantee that I'll be able to fix it.

﻿I'm planning to release a template version of the vanilla asset cutouts + the finished code for other people to easily create their own dirt recolors as well. I just need to add the code for seasonal colors, since I'm sure many people would prefer the option of different colors for different seasons.
